requirements.statement: While the IWDG LL driver is active, the IWDG LL driver shall not write to the IWDG_SR.EWIF field.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the IWDG_SR.EWIF field is read as zero after reset and no function modifies this field.

requirements.statement: While the IWDG LL driver is active, the IWDG LL driver shall return 1U if the IWDG_SR.ONF bit is set and 0U otherwise.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the IWDG_SR.ONF field is read correctly after enabling the watchdog via a call to the appropriate LL function.

requirements.statement: While the IWDG LL driver is active, the IWDG LL driver shall not write to the IWDG_SR.EWU field.
requirements.verification: The host unit test passes when the IWDG_SR.EWU field is read as zero after reset and no function modifies this field.
